articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Sets Record as Largest Ever, Expands to Two Buildings
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo 2026 made history as the largest iteration of the global attractions industry's premier event, spanning a record 630,000 square feet across two buildings at the Orange County Convention Center for the first time. The expansion signals continued growth and investment momentum across the attractions sector. FEC operators and suppliers should take note of the scale of new product launches and partnerships announced at this year's show.

articles.title: Triotech Unveils Five New Products at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Largest Release in Company History
articles.summary: Triotech, a leading developer of immersive media-based attractions, launched five new products at IAAPA Expo 2026 in what the company called its largest product release ever. The announcements are significant for FEC operators looking to add interactive and media-based attractions to their lineup. Details on the specific products are expected to generate considerable interest among venue operators seeking differentiated guest experiences.

articles.title: 2026 IAAPA Brass Ring Award Winners Announced for Best Exhibit and Best New Product
articles.summary: The IAAPA Brass Ring Awards, among the most prestigious honors in the attractions industry, announced their 2026 winners for Best Exhibit and Best New Product at this year's expo. These awards highlight the most innovative products and technologies entering the market, giving FEC operators a curated shortlist of standout solutions. Tracking Brass Ring winners is a useful benchmark for operators evaluating new attractions and equipment investments.

articles.title: Little Lion Entertainment and SEGA Partner on Interactive Karting Experience in London
articles.summary: Little Lion Entertainment and SEGA have teamed up to create an interactive karting attraction at Arcade Arena London that blends physical karts with projection technology, real-time tracking, and competitive gameplay inspired by video games. The experience reimagines traditional go-kart racing as an arena-scale gaming adventure where digital worlds respond to racers in real time. This concept is a strong signal for FEC operators considering how to elevate karting beyond traditional track racing with immersive tech layers.

articles.title: RWS Global Identifies Top Experiential Trends Set to Shape Live Entertainment in 2027
articles.summary: RWS Global has released its outlook on the top trends shaping live entertainment in 2027, noting that consumers are increasingly prioritizing memorable experiences over material purchases and seeking deeper emotional engagement. The report draws on insights from work with major global brands and is relevant to FEC operators planning programming and experience upgrades for the year ahead. Understanding these demand-side shifts can help operators make smarter investments in entertainment offerings.

articles.title: Red Raion Partners with Hasbro to Create Power Rangers Media-Based Attraction
articles.summary: CGI studio Red Raion has signed a licensing deal with Hasbro to produce a Power Rangers-themed attraction available in 5D, VR, dome, and flying theater formats for worldwide licensing to theme parks and location-based entertainment venues. The multigenerational appeal of the Power Rangers franchise makes this a potentially strong draw for FEC operators with media-based attraction infrastructure. Release timing has not yet been announced.

articles.title: Red Raion Developing Power Rangers Content for 5D, VR, Dome, and Flying Theaters
articles.summary: Red Raion is producing Power Rangers-branded attraction content in multiple formats including 5D, VR, dome, and flying theaters, available for licensing by parks and entertainment venues globally. The content leverages the franchise's broad generational recognition to drive repeat visitation across family demographics. FEC operators with motion simulators or immersive theater setups should watch for licensing availability.

articles.title: Mattel City Resort Grows from 9 to 14 Acres with Major New Investment at VAI Resort
articles.summary: VAI Resort and Mattel have revealed an expanded vision for Mattel City, an entertainment destination resort in Glendale, Arizona, that has grown from a 9-acre to a 14-acre development representing a significant additional investment in the multi-billion-dollar property. The expansion of IP-driven destination entertainment resorts reflects a broader trend that FEC operators should monitor as branded experience destinations compete for family leisure spending. The project underscores the growing role of toy and entertainment IP in anchoring large-scale leisure developments.

articles.title: Mattel Adventure Park in Glendale Rebranded as 'Mattel City' with Expanded Plans
articles.summary: The Mattel-branded entertainment park in Glendale, Arizona has been renamed Mattel City and is pursuing a larger development footprint, signaling growing ambitions for IP-driven family entertainment destinations. The rebranding and expansion reflect increasing investment by major toy brands in location-based entertainment. FEC operators should consider how branded IP partnerships and destination entertainment models are reshaping competitive dynamics in family leisure.

articles.title: Level99 to Open Life-Size Games and Challenges Venue in West Hartford, Connecticut
articles.summary: Level99, the immersive adult entertainment concept featuring life-size puzzle games and physical challenges, is opening a new location in West Hartford, Connecticut. The brand's expansion into new markets highlights continued consumer demand for active, challenge-based group entertainment experiences. FEC operators competing in the adult and young adult segment should take note of Level99's growth trajectory and experience model.

articles.title: Slick City Action Park to Open New Location in San Antonio
articles.summary: Slick City Action Park, the indoor slide park concept, is expanding with a new location in San Antonio, Texas, continuing its growth as a category-defining indoor active entertainment brand. The chain's expansion reflects strong consumer appetite for affordable, high-energy indoor attractions that appeal to families and teens. FEC operators in competitive markets should monitor Slick City's footprint as it enters new regional markets.

articles.title: Indoor Park with 25-Foot Slides to Open in Boise Next Month
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment venue featuring 25-foot slides is set to open in Boise, Idaho, adding another active-play option to the local family entertainment market. The opening reflects the continued proliferation of indoor slide and active-play concepts in secondary markets across the US. FEC operators in similar markets should track this format's expansion as it creates new direct competition for family leisure time and spending.

articles.title: Former Supermarket in Fort Wayne to Be Converted into Indoor Slide Park
articles.summary: A former Marsh supermarket building in Fort Wayne, Indiana is being repurposed as an indoor slide park, illustrating a growing trend of converting vacant retail space into family entertainment venues. This adaptive reuse model is increasingly common as FEC operators seek affordable large-footprint locations in suburban markets. The conversion highlights both the real estate opportunity and the competitive expansion of indoor active entertainment concepts.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment Center has opened a new location in Denton, Texas, expanding the brand's presence in the North Texas market. The opening adds to the growing density of trampoline and active play FEC concepts in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area. Operators in competitive urban markets should track Launch's expansion as the brand continues to build regional scale.

articles.title: Two FEC Properties Listed for Sale Through IRM, Including Texas Park with Growth Potential
articles.summary: IRM is seeking qualified buyers for two family entertainment park properties, including Outlaw Pass, a mid-sized FEC in Texas described as having significant room for growth and market expansion. The listings represent acquisition opportunities for investors and operators looking to enter or expand in the FEC space. Prospective buyers should evaluate these properties as the broader FEC M&A market remains active.

articles.title: Oveit Unifies Ticketing, Payments, Lockers, and Rentals at Cap St Georges Water Park
articles.summary: Oveit's integrated platform is managing the full guest journey at Cap St Georges Hotel & Resort's new water park in Cyprus, covering ticketing, entry gates, locker access, rentals, and cashless spending all connected to room keys and waterproof wristbands. The system allows hotel guests and day visitors to be managed seamlessly within a single platform, with charges settling at hotel checkout. FEC operators running hybrid resort-and-park models will find this unified approach to payments and access control highly relevant.

articles.title: Madison County Approves TIF Funding Mechanism for 'The Gallery' Entertainment Development
articles.summary: Madison County, Mississippi has approved a Tax Increment Financing structure to support The Gallery, a retail, dining, and entertainment development that includes a family entertainment center component. The approval of up to $11.74 million in TIF borrowing signals local government willingness to use public financing tools to attract FEC-anchored mixed-use developments. Developers and operators planning new venue construction should monitor TIF availability in their target markets as a viable funding mechanism.

articles.title: Madison, Mississippi Approves $11.74 Million TIF Borrowing for Retail and Dining Development
articles.summary: The City of Madison, Mississippi has approved up to $11.741 million in Tax Increment Financing borrowing to support a mixed-use retail, dining, and entertainment development. Projects like this demonstrate how municipalities are actively incentivizing FEC-anchored developments as economic drivers. FEC operators and developers should be aware of TIF programs as a potential source of development capital in suburban growth markets.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Introduces AI-Powered Rider Safety Detection System for Waterless Surf Attractions
articles.summary: BrushBoarding has patented a camera-based safety system for its waterless surfing attraction that continuously monitors riders, automatically stops brushes if a fall is detected, and verifies that protective gear is properly worn before a session begins. The technology reduces the need for constant staff supervision while improving safety compliance and guest confidence. FEC operators running active ride attractions should take note of how automated safety detection can reduce liability exposure and staffing requirements.

articles.title: Disney Unveils Autonomous AI-Powered Animatronic Characters That Interact with Guests Without Puppeteering
articles.summary: Walt Disney Imagineering has revealed three AI-powered animatronic Anzellan characters that can perceive and respond to guests in real time using Amazon Web Services technology, with no human operator required. The characters represent a leap forward in autonomous character interaction for themed entertainment environments. While developed at Disney scale, the technology signals where guest-facing AI interactivity is heading for the broader attractions industry.

articles.title: Six Retail Principles from European Theme Parks That Can Drive Secondary Spend at Any Attraction
articles.summary: A practical analysis of retail strategy at European theme parks outlines six proven principles for increasing secondary spend, including showcasing hero products and enhancing guest loyalty through merchandise. The article draws on real-world case studies and is applicable to any visitor attraction looking to grow non-admission revenue. FEC operators seeking to improve retail performance will find actionable takeaways relevant to their own gift shops and merchandise offerings.

articles.title: Dippin' Dots Launches Limited-Edition Strawberry Shortcake Flavor for Spring 2027 Venue Distribution
articles.summary: Dippin' Dots is introducing a limited-time Strawberry Shortcake Ice Cream flavor for spring 2027, available in bulk for franchisees and entertainment venues including FECs. Limited-time offerings drive incremental F&B revenue and create buzz among regular guests. FEC operators with Dippin' Dots concessions should plan to stock the new flavor to capitalize on seasonal interest.

articles.title: UK's First Human Claw Machine Opens in Leicester as City Becomes Indoor Entertainment Hub
articles.summary: Leicester has opened the UK's first human claw machine attraction, part of a broader clustering of indoor entertainment venues that is turning the city centre into a destination for experiential leisure. The human claw machine format is a novel, shareable attraction concept with strong social media appeal and low operational complexity. FEC operators looking for differentiated, low-footprint novelty attractions should consider how formats like this can add incremental revenue and guest engagement.

articles.title: Four Lake Houston-Area Entertainment Venues Share Expansion and Operational Updates
articles.summary: Four family and group entertainment venues in the Lake Houston area of Texas have shared updates on their operations, expansions, and offerings, reflecting the competitive density of the suburban Houston FEC market. The updates provide a snapshot of how regional FEC operators are adapting their models to local demand. Operators in similarly competitive suburban markets can benchmark their own strategies against these local examples.

articles.title: Omaha Property at 3002 Dodge Street Proposed for Conversion to Indoor Entertainment Venue
articles.summary: A commercial property at 3002 Dodge Street in Omaha, Nebraska is being considered for redevelopment as an indoor entertainment venue, reflecting broader trends in adaptive reuse of commercial real estate for FEC purposes. The proposal illustrates ongoing demand for indoor entertainment in Midwest suburban markets. Operators and developers tracking real estate conversion opportunities for FEC use will find this a relevant market indicator.

articles.title: New Indoor Entertainment Venue Planned for Amble, UK with Multiple Activity Offerings
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment venue offering a range of activities is set to open in Amble, Northumberland, adding to the growing number of multi-activity FEC-style venues launching in smaller UK towns. The trend of bringing indoor active entertainment to smaller communities reflects expanding consumer demand beyond major urban centres. UK-based FEC operators and suppliers should note the continued geographic spread of the market.

articles.title: LEOS Enters US Market at IAAPA Expo 2026, Partnering with ADG for Aquatic Venue Operations
articles.summary: Leisure and Entertainment Operational Services (LEOS) announced its entry into the US market at IAAPA Expo 2026, building on its relationship with Aquatic Development Group to offer operational planning, opening readiness, and park management services to US water park and aquatic destination developers. The move brings international FEC operational expertise to a market where many new aquatic and entertainment venues are under development. Developers and investors planning new water park or aquatic FEC projects should consider LEOS as a potential operational partner.

articles.title: Blooloop Innovation Awards 2026 Public Vote Now Open Across Attractions Industry
articles.summary: The blooloop Innovation Awards 2026, presented in partnership with Area15, have opened public voting across categories recognizing innovation in technology, design, guest experience, and operations within the global visitor attractions industry. The awards provide FEC operators and suppliers with a curated view of the most forward-thinking products and projects in the sector. Reviewing the entries is a practical way for operators to discover emerging solutions and benchmark their own innovation efforts.
